clue.text: Whale to blow endlessly, about to rise?

indicators.note: about means the shortened word goes around the other piece
endlessly means the word for blow loses its final letter

parts.note: to gush is to blow out or spout, as a whale does
to ramp is to rise up, as a slope or prices do

explanation.surface: A whale surfacing to spout, endlessly blowing as it comes up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endlessly' drops the last letter of the word for blow, and 'about' wraps what is left around the word for rise. The question mark admits the definition is an old name.
explanation.definitionFit: Grampus is an old name for the killer whale or Risso's dolphin, a toothed cetacean.

clue.text: Understand good parent avoids force

indicators.note: avoids means the parent word leaves out the letter for force

parts.note: a father is a parent
F is the physics symbol for force

explanation.surface: A decent parent steers clear of violence, and gets it.
explanation.definitionFit: To gather can mean to infer or conclude, as in 'I gather you're leaving'.

clue.text: A heavy arrow mostly is hard to stop

indicators.note: mostly means the arrow word loses its final letter

parts.note: a bolt is a short heavy arrow shot from a crossbow
H is the pencil-grading abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: A weighty crossbow shot is difficult to halt.
explanation.definitionFit: To abolish is to end something officially, which is to put a stop to it.

clue.text: Quickly suggest reduced hydrogen in sample

indicators.note: reduced means the word for suggest loses its last letter

parts.note: to pose an idea is to suggest or put it forward

indicators.note: in means the hydrogen symbol goes inside the word for sample

parts.note: to taste something is to sample it, and a taste is a sample
H is the chemical symbol for hydrogen

explanation.surface: A lab note proposing a cut-down quantity of hydrogen in a test specimen, fast.
explanation.definitionFit: Posthaste is an adverb meaning with all possible speed, so it means quickly.

clue.text: Revolutionary counts least in revolution?

indicators.note: in revolution means the letters are turned over and rearranged

explanation.surface: A rebel for whom numbers matter least once the uprising begins.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in revolution' doubles as a nod to the French Revolution, where the answer belongs.
explanation.definitionFit: Sansculotte was the name for a radical republican of the French Revolution, so a revolutionary.

clue.text: Demand navy to attend old Italian port

parts.note: sale can mean the demand for a commodity, as in 'there is no sale for it'
RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: Requesting that the fleet call at a historic port in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old' looks like part of the definition, but it gives O; the definition is just 'Italian port'. 'to attend' simply joins the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Salerno is a seaport on the south-west coast of Italy, site of the 1943 Allied landings.

clue.text: Something identifying sibling, primarily

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of each of the three words is taken

explanation.surface: A label that marks someone out as a brother or sister.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both wordplay and definition: the initials spell a short name that identifies a sibling.
explanation.definitionFit: Sis is the familiar shortening of sister, used to address or name a female sibling.

clue.text: Proposition from Frenchman, then married in the country

indicators.note: in means the two letters go inside the word for country

parts.note: a lea is a meadow, open countryside
M is the abbreviation for Monsieur, a Frenchman

explanation.surface: A Frenchman's offer, then a wedding out in the countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'then' simply sets the second M after the first.
explanation.definitionFit: A lemma is a subsidiary proposition proved to help establish a theorem.

clue.text: Othello's setback mostly provided by Iago, principally

definitions.note: the 's is read as 'is', so the definition is Othello itself

indicators.note: mostly means the setback word loses its final letter

parts.note: a reverse is a setback or defeat

indicators.note: principally means the first letter of Iago is taken

explanation.surface: The Moor's downfall, largely brought about by Iago in the play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Othello' is not Shakespeare's Moor here but the board game, also sold as Reversi.
explanation.definitionFit: Othello is the trade name for the disc-flipping board game reversi, played on an eight by eight grid.

clue.text: Studying wine, upset one over record year

indicators.note: upset means the letters of one are knocked over and rearranged

parts.note: O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
a log is a record, as in a ship's log

explanation.surface: A wine student, upset that someone has spent another year on record.
explanation.definitionFit: Oenology is the science and study of wine and winemaking.

clue.text: A great many you once observed beside coastal feature

parts.note: thou is the archaic form of you
sands are the beaches along a coast

explanation.surface: Someone in olden days noticed by a stretch of beach.
explanation.definitionFit: Thousands is used loosely for a huge but uncounted number, so it stands for a great many.

clue.text: Players welcoming a very dab hand

indicators.note: welcoming means the players take the other letters inside them

parts.note: men are the players or pieces in a board game

explanation.surface: A team of players taking in someone extremely skilled.
explanation.definitionFit: A maven is an expert or connoisseur, which is what a dab hand is in British idiom.

clue.text: Time to return, pursued by hot woman

indicators.note: to return means the word for time is read backwards

parts.note: tide is an old word for time, as in Christmastide
H is the abbreviation for hot, as on taps

explanation.surface: Time to head home, chased by an attractive woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Time' is the old word seen in Eastertide, not T; 'pursued by' sets H last.
explanation.definitionFit: Edith is a female first name, so it is an example of a woman in crossword style.

clue.text: Fellow arrives beside a large thicket of trees

parts.note: chap is an informal word for a fellow
arr. is the timetable abbreviation for arrives
L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A man turns up next to a big thicket.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaparral is dense scrubby woodland of dwarf oaks and shrubs found in California and Mexico.

clue.text: A conifer ultimately carried aroma resembling a tree

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of conifer is taken

parts.note: bore is the past tense of bear, to carry
a scent is an aroma

explanation.surface: A pine tree that in the end gave off a smell like a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Arborescent describes something tree-like in growth or shape, from Latin arbor.

clue.text: Tackling corruption with his band, reversing poor showing in Government

indicators.note: reversing means the word for band is read backwards

parts.note: a belt is a band worn round the waist
a low is a poor showing or bad result

explanation.surface: A musician's band tackling sleaze, with a dismal performance in office.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as one long sentence, but every small word ('with', 'his', 'in') is a piece of the answer; 'reversing' turns BELT into TLEB.
explanation.definitionFit: Whistleblowing is exposing wrongdoing in an organisation, which is a way of tackling corruption.

clue.text: Paper describing the leek?

definitions.meaning: the leek belongs to the onion family

explanation.walkthrough: The second definition reads the answer as ONION'S KIN, a relative of the onion.
explanation.definitionFit: Onionskin is lightweight glossy writing paper, named for its resemblance to an onion's skin.

clue.text: No time at all to get wind of wild film idea

indicators.note: no time at all means every letter T for time is taken out of the pieces

parts.note: to scent something is to get wind of it
a riot of something is a wild profusion, and to run riot is to go wild

explanation.surface: No time to pick up on an unruly concept for a movie.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No time at all' removes both T's, one from SCENT and one from A RIOT; the setter confirmed A RIOT for 'wild'.
explanation.definitionFit: A scenario is the outline or plot of a film, the basic idea it develops.

clue.text: Male in pursuit of fancy electric tools — something one has to have?

indicators.note: fancy as an adjective means elaborate or reworked, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man chasing after flashy power tools that he simply must own.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in pursuit of' puts M after the anagram of ELECTRIC TOOLS.
explanation.definitionFit: A collector's item is a highly desirable object, the kind of thing an enthusiast feels they must own.

clue.text: Clear criminal over US city crime

indicators.note: criminal as an adjective suggests something bent, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: NY is New York

explanation.surface: A wrongdoer's acquittal on top of the crime rate in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' places LARCE, the anagram of CLEAR, above NY in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Larceny is the legal term for theft of personal property, a crime.

clue.text: Accept support after not-so-brief space

indicators.note: after means the support comes second, following the printing space

parts.note: in printing an em space is wider than an en space, so it is the longer one
a brace is a support

explanation.surface: Taking on backing after a longer pause.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not-so-brief space' contrasts the em with the narrower en space of typesetting.
explanation.definitionFit: To embrace an idea or offer is to accept it willingly.

clue.text: Agent, having secured shelter, ready to go out?

indicators.note: having secured means the agent holds the shelter inside

parts.note: a spy is a secret agent
lee is the sheltered side, away from the wind

explanation.surface: A spy who has found cover is set to head off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'go out' means drop off to sleep, not leave the house.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone sleepy is about to nod off, that is, ready to lose consciousness.

clue.text: Small second soccer team around end of October regressed, becoming flabby

indicators.note: regressed means the whole assembly goes backwards

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
S is the abbreviation for second, as in a time unit

indicators.note: around means the soccer team goes round the letter taken from October

parts.note: a football side has eleven players, so a team is an eleven

indicators.note: end of means the last letter of the word October is used

explanation.surface: A minor reserve football side slipping back around the end of October and growing out of shape.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regressed' reverses SSELEVREN, the string built from S, S and ELEVEN wrapped around R.
explanation.definitionFit: Nerveless can mean lacking vigour or firmness, hence limp and slack.

clue.text: Carefully observe confirmation of a palindrome?

definitions.meaning: to look at closely or appraisingly
the word eye is a palindrome, and reading it up the grid confirms it reads the same both ways

explanation.walkthrough: In this down entry EYE read UP is still EYE, which shows it is a palindrome.
explanation.definitionFit: To eye up is a British idiom for inspecting someone or something closely.

clue.text: Swedish inventor's book appearing in festive season

definitions.note: the 's is read as 'is', so the definition is the Swedish inventor himself

indicators.note: appearing in means the letter for book sits inside the season

parts.note: Noel is Christmas

explanation.surface: A Swedish inventor's book coming out at Christmas.
explanation.definitionFit: Alfred Nobel, the Swede who invented dynamite, founded the prizes that carry his name.

clue.text: Former Hollywood actor appearing in bizarre event

indicators.note: appearing in means the answer is found within the letters of the following words

explanation.surface: A past film star turning up at a strange occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Christopher Reeve was the American film actor best known for playing Superman; he died in 2004.

clue.text: End of game sees friend following regular pattern

indicators.note: following means the friend comes second, after the pattern

parts.note: check is a pattern of regular squares, as in a check shirt
mate is British slang for a friend

explanation.surface: The close of a match where a pal comes after a tartan design.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition sits at the front: 'End of game' is the chess finish, not a last letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Checkmate is the position that ends a chess match with the king trapped.

clue.text: Reduction in price for salad vegetable

indicators.note: reduction in means the word for price is cut short by one letter

parts.note: cost is price

explanation.surface: A price cut on a salad ingredient.
explanation.definitionFit: Cos is a variety of lettuce with long crisp leaves, also called romaine.

clue.text: Mount finale of festival, blocking version of my opus

indicators.note: blocking means the letter sits in the middle of the other letters, obstructing them
a version of something is a rearranged form, so the letters are reworked
finale of means the last letter of the word festival is taken

explanation.surface: The closing piece of a music festival interrupting a performance of a composer's own work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'blocking' puts L inside OYMPUS, the anagram of MY OPUS signalled by 'version of'.
explanation.definitionFit: Olympus is a mountain in Greece, the home of the gods in myth, so it is a mount.

clue.text: Attempt to secure outbuilding that's ditched by leather works

indicators.note: to secure means the attempt holds the other piece inside it

parts.note: a try is an attempt

indicators.note: that's ditched means the following letter is dropped from the outbuilding

parts.note: an annex is an extra building attached to or beside a main one
by is the multiplication sign X, as in three by four

explanation.surface: Trying to keep an extension that a leather firm is getting rid of.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' gives X as in dimensions or multiplication (a 3 by 4 room), and 'that's ditched' drops it from the outbuilding.
explanation.definitionFit: A tannery is a place where animal hides are tanned into leather, so a leather works.
